# Trend Ads

> Trend Ads (https://www.trend-ads.com) is a high-impact creative advertising and digital engineering studio based in Thrissur, Kerala, India, delivering global client solutions. We engineer category-defining brand identities, high-ROAS paid media systems (Meta, Google, TikTok), high-converting Next.js digital platforms, and viral commercial content.

## Core Services & Disciplines
- **Paid Ads & Performance Scaling**: Data-driven customer acquisition on Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram), Google Search/Performance Max, and TikTok Ads with proven 4.8x average ROAS.
- **Next.js Web Engineering & Digital Products**: Ultra-fast, SEO-optimized, highly responsive web platforms engineered with Next.js, React 19, and Tailwind CSS.
- **Brand Strategy & Visual Systems**: Distinctive visual identities, typographic guidelines, design systems, and category positioning.
- **Viral Content & Video Production**: High-retention short-form video, creative commercial production, and conversion copywriting.
- **Full-Funnel CRO & Analytics**: Heatmap analysis, landing page conversion rate optimization, and behavioral event tracking.

## Core Topics & Capabilities
- **Digital Marketing Agency & Services**: Full-spectrum agency services covering strategy, campaign execution, CRO, and digital engineering.
- **Social Media Marketing & Content Creation**: Performance social media marketing, content marketing, viral video production, and commercial media.
- **Meta Ads Ecosystem**: Meta Ads Manager scaling, Meta Ads Library intelligence, creative testing, and Facebook/Instagram performance ads.
- **Google Ads Ecosystem**: Google Ads Manager, Google Search Ads, YouTube Ads, Google Ads Account optimization, and Google Business Profile scaling.
- **Website Design & Mobile App Development**: Custom business websites, Next.js engineering, website design, native/cross-platform app development, and online business infrastructure.
- **AI & Emerging Technologies**: AI digital marketing integration, advanced attribution modeling, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization).
